g.text: Which lane holds which number in mma.m16n8k16
The number in each cell is the lane of the warp that holds it in its registers.
Lane 0 is dark, and lane 1 is light red. Each lane holds 8 numbers of A,
k runs along A. Lane 0 holds columns 0, 1, 8 and 9 of rows 0 and 8.
Each 32-bit register holds 2 neighboring numbers along k.
